name: Image-to-Mesh Extraction via Neural Implicit Fields
aliases: Image-to-Mesh Extraction via Neural Implicit Fields — TripoSR Mesh Extraction
definition: Pipeline that converts a 2D image into a 3D triangle mesh with vertex colors using the TripoSR neural model and Marching Cubes extraction.
summary: Image-to-Mesh Extraction via Neural Implicit Fields converts single 2D images into textured 3D meshes using TripoSR, distinguishing itself by performing batch inference in a single pass to directly output meshes with vertex colors.
